fe-design-archetype.detail: Timeline + rail (decision recorded in az-planting-calendar/design-refs/home-options/DECISION.md). Re-confirmed by opening evidence/screenshots/az-planting-calendar-1280-light.png at commit 9498a6c: a horizontal half-month timeline (Mar 1 .. Sep 1 labels, current half-month boxed 'now') spans the page width above a 'Plantable in Aug 1' list of crop cards (name, seed/transplant badge, days-to-harvest, source link) as the primary reading column, with a docked 'Planting assistant' panel to the right as a secondary rail, and a separate full-year grid (24 half-month columns x crop rows) below -- a timeline spine with a rail, not a tile/card grid or a single hero card.
